source.selection_rule: For each of the six highest-priority common status moves, select the most frequent tuple of current opponent species, accumulated revealed moves for that species, and public lead status in the corrected 256-battle coverage artifact; break ties lexicographically.

hypothesis: For the selected common status-move information patterns, two disjoint deterministic Showdown generator seed families yield the same nonempty hidden-item support and item-weight distributions within total-variation distance 0.1, with at least 32 conditioned matches per family.
non_claims: This does not establish that status moves are sufficient by themselves for competitive-optimal play.
This does not promote status-move priors into the live player.
This tests generator-conditioned hidden-item support only; exact transition/search behavior remains a separate promotion requirement.
